lead: The rules at a glance. School announcements take priority.

sections.title: Arrival & Pick-Up
items: After 10:00 AM is late: park, sign the tardy form at the desk, or take your child home.
More than 3 late arrivals in a quarter: no class on further late days.
Pick up at 1:30 PM. $1/minute per child after that.
Leaving early: only at break, with the early-departure form.

sections.title: Attendance
items: Report every absence on the online form.
Long absence? Tell both teachers and make up the work.
3 unexcused absences in a row may mean suspension. List sports conflicts at the start of the year.

sections.title: Dress Code
items: Modest, loose clothing at school and all events. No offensive prints.
Girls: headscarf covering hair and neck, long sleeves, ankle-length skirts or full pants.
Boys: full-length loose pants, no shorts.
Grade 5+: a warning first, then parents are contacted.

sections.title: Conduct & Safety
items: Respect everyone; no bad language.
Phones off. No toys, games or headphones.
Closed campus. No skateboards or roller shoes. No recording.
No guests in classrooms without permission.

sections.title: Prayer
items: Assembly at 10:00 AM. Dhuhr at 1:15 PM is required; please don’t leave before it. Parents welcome.

sections.title: Food & Snacks
items: Snacks are included, served by a volunteer family each month.
Eat in the courtyard only, never in classrooms.
Ramadan: no school snacks. KG–Gr 2 may bring their own, eaten away from others.

sections.title: Homework & Report Cards
items: Homework comes by email; younger grades bring a sheet for parents to sign.
Reports are emailed in December and June.
Pass both subjects to move up. Honor roll (Gr 3+): A’s in both.

sections.title: Volunteering
items: 10 hours per family per year: 5 in Aug–Dec, 5 in Jan–May.
Teacher’s aide, room parent, snacks, events and more. Sign up at registration.

sections.title: Books to Keep
items: Our Book of Dua (Gr 2–4) · Let’s Read & Write Arabic II (Gr 2–3) · Juz Amma Vol. 1 (Gr 4–5) · A Study of Hadith (Gr 6–7) · Selected Prayers (Gr 7–8)
Lost books must be paid for.

sections.title: Campus & Online Days
items: We’re guests at Greene Middle School: damage can mean fines. Label belongings; there’s no lost and found.
Virtual days run on Zoom, same schedule. Cameras on, don’t share links; KG parents stay with their child.
